from ortools.sat.python import cp_model

def solve_covering_design(n=10, num_trips=6):
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    students = 2 * n
    trips = [[model.NewBoolVar(f'trip_{i}_student_{j}') for j in range(students)] for i in range(num_trips)]

    # Ensure each trip has exactly n students
    for t in trips:
        model.Add(sum(t) == n)

    # Every pair of students should appear together in at least one trip
    for i in range(students):
        for j in range(i + 1, students):
            appears_together = [trips[k][i] + trips[k][j] >= 2 for k in range(num_trips)]
            model.AddBoolOr(appears_together)

    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    if status == cp_model.OPTIMAL or status == cp_model.FEASIBLE:
        return [[solver.Value(trips[t][s]) for s in range(students)] for t in range(num_trips)]
    else:
        return None

solution = solve_covering_design()
print(solution)

from ortools.sat.python import cp_model

def create_schedule(n, num_trips):
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    # Define variables
    A = {}
    for i in range(num_trips):  # Trips
        for j in range(2 * n):  # Students
            A[i, j] = model.NewBoolVar(f'A_{i}_{j}')
    
    # Ensure exactly n students go on each trip
    for i in range(num_trips):
        model.Add(sum(A[i, j] for j in range(2 * n)) == n)
    
    # Ensure each pair of students go on at least one trip together
    for j1 in range(2 * n):
        for j2 in range(j1 + 1, 2 * n):
            model.Add(sum(A[i, j1] + A[i, j2] >= 2 for i in range(num_trips)) >= 1)
    
    # Solve the model
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status == cp_model.OPTIMAL or status == cp_model.FEASIBLE:
        # Extract solution
        schedule = [[int(solver.Value(A[i, j])) for j in range(2 * n)] for i in range(num_trips)]
        return schedule
    else:
        raise ValueError("No feasible solution found")
